question: 10 women can complete a work in 15 days. The same work can be completed in 5 days by 15 men. 10 women started the work and after 3 days, 5 men replaced 5 women. In how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
Given:

10 women can complete a work in 15 days. The same work can be completed in 5 days by 15 men. 

10 women started the work and after 3 days, 5 men replaced 5 women.

Concept used:

Total work = Number of workers × Efficiency of each worker × Days to complete the work

Calculation:

Let the total work be 150 units.

Efficiency of each woman = 150 ÷ (10 × 15) = 1 units

Efficiency of each man = 150 ÷ (15 × 5) = 2 units

Work done in 3 days = 10 × 1 × 3 = 30 units

Remaining work = 150 - 30 = 120 units

5 women and 5 men together complete in 1 day = 5 × 2 + 5 × 1 = 15 units

So, the remaining work will be done in = 120/15 = 8 days

Now, the work will be completed = 8 + 3 = 11 days

∴ The work will be completed in 11 days.
